bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to vocational rehabilitation; requiring rulemaking expanding eligibility for the extended employment program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+RULEMAKING; EXTENDED EMPLOYMENT PROGRAM. +]

[+(a) The commissioner of employment and economic development must adopt rules allowing individuals on a medical assistance waiver, regardless of the waiver service the individual is receiving, to receive extended employment services through the extended employment program. Participation in the extended employment program may be conditioned on the submission of a form, developed by the commissioner, that documents that the individual is receiving separate services from each program and that no services are being reimbursed by more than one program. +]

[+(b) The commissioner of employment and economic development must adopt rules repealing Minnesota Rules, part 3300.6005, subpart 1, item B. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to vocational rehabilitation; requiring rulemaking expanding eligibility for the extended employment program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. RULEMAKING; EXTENDED EMPLOYMENT PROGRAM.

(a) The commissioner of employment and economic development must adopt rules allowing individuals on a medical assistance waiver, regardless of the waiver service the individual is receiving, to receive extended employment services through the extended employment program. Participation in the extended employment program may be conditioned on the submission of a form, developed by the commissioner, that documents that the individual is receiving separate services from each program and that no services are being reimbursed by more than one program.

(b) The commissioner of employment and economic development must adopt rules repealing Minnesota Rules, part 3300.6005, subpart 1, item B.
additions: (a) The commissioner of employment and economic development must adopt rules allowing individuals on a medical assistance waiver, regardless of the waiver service the individual is receiving, to receive extended employment services through the extended employment program. Participation in the extended employment program may be conditioned on the submission of a form, developed by the commissioner, that documents that the individual is receiving separate services from each program and that no services are being reimbursed by more than one program.
(b) The commissioner of employment and economic development must adopt rules repealing Minnesota Rules, part 3300.6005, subpart 1, item B.
